messages.content: Please recheck the three St. George Island places for September 20-27. We are ready to reserve one room for two adults if the full checkout price and cancellation terms still make sense.

I rechecked the full seven-night stay. Buccaneer Inn no longer has one room available for all seven nights. The 49 Palmetto rental is still open, but checkout now shows a $395 cleaning fee that was not included in the prior figure, raising the complete total to $2,263.92. St. George Inn remains available with two room choices: a standard king at $1,842.24 total and a king suite with a separate sitting area and kitchenette at $2,016.68 total. Would you like the payment and cancellation terms for the two St. George Inn rooms?
Yes. Also confirm whether either total can increase later because of resort fees or cleaning charges.

Both St. George Inn totals include the room rate, state and local taxes, and the property's listed mandatory charges. Neither room has a resort fee or cleaning fee. The standard king is $1,842.24 and the king suite is $2,016.68. A one-night room-and-tax deposit is charged when booked, with the remainder due at check-in. Incidental purchases and any damage charges would be separate.
What are the exact cancellation terms now? Last time the whole stay became nonrefundable after the deadline, and I want to make sure that has not changed.

That term is unchanged for both room types. Cancellation is free through 3:00 p.m. local hotel time on September 13. After that deadline, the full seven-night room charge and tax are nonrefundable. A no-show is also charged the complete stay.
And 49 Palmetto is really $2,263.92 all in now? Break out what changed.

Yes. Its current checkout total is $2,263.92: $1,345.00 base rent, $395.00 cleaning, $188.00 management fee, $79.00 damage waiver, and $256.92 in taxes. The newly displayed cleaning charge accounts for the increase from the earlier $1,868.92 quote. Payment is 50% at booking and the balance is due August 21. Cancellations before August 21 receive a refund less the management fee; from August 21 through September 5, 50% of rent is retained; beginning September 6, all payments are nonrefundable.
That removes the rental. Compare the two inn rooms on the practical differences, not just the $174.44 price gap.

The standard king is one 285-square-foot room with a king bed, mini-fridge, microwave, and coffee maker. The king suite is approximately 430 square feet and adds a separate sitting area with a sofa plus a kitchenette with a sink, larger refrigerator, microwave, and basic dishes; it does not have a stove. Both are reached by exterior corridors, have the same roughly three-minute walk to the beach with a crossing of Gulf Beach Drive, and carry the same payment and cancellation rules.
Does the suite have a second bed? The sofa is not important unless it opens.

The listing identifies the sofa as a queen sleeper sofa, so the suite can sleep up to four. The standard king sleeps two. For two adults, the suite's functional advantages are the extra room, separate sitting area, larger refrigerator, sink, and dishes.
Then the standard king is enough. Before booking, verify the dates, occupancy, total, deposit, and deadline one last time.

Final review: St. George Inn, arrival Saturday, September 20, departure Saturday, September 27, seven nights, one standard king room for two adults. The complete quoted total is $1,842.24 with all currently listed taxes and mandatory property charges included. The booking charge is a one-night room-and-tax deposit of $263.18; the remaining $1,579.06 is due at check-in. Free cancellation ends at 3:00 p.m. local hotel time on September 13, after which the full stay is nonrefundable.
Book that standard king at St. George Inn. Use the traveler and payment details already on file, and do not add any optional coverage or extras.

The reservation is confirmed at St. George Inn for September 20-27: one standard king room, two adults, seven nights. The confirmed total is $1,842.24. A $263.18 deposit was charged to the payment method on file, and $1,579.06 is due at check-in. No optional coverage or extras were added. Free cancellation is available until 3:00 p.m. local hotel time on September 13; after that, the entire stay is nonrefundable. Confirmation number: SGI-927416.
